content.short: Auro Finance is a DeFi protocol on Aptos offering liquid staking for APT and a decentralized stablecoin called USDA.
content.description: Auro Finance is a DeFi protocol on the Aptos blockchain specializing in liquid staking and stablecoin minting. It enables users to stake APT tokens to earn network rewards while receiving a liquid representation for use across other DeFi applications. This allows participants to maintain liquidity and pursue yield opportunities without sacrificing their staking positions. Auro Finance also features the USDA stablecoin, which users can borrow against staked assets or collateral. By providing automated yield optimization, the protocol aims to maximize returns for liquidity providers on Aptos. Auro Finance is dedicated to building secure infrastructure that enhances capital efficiency for Web3 users.
